name: POST /api/admin/auth/logout - End the admin session
description: Ends the platform admin session and records the logout in the admin audit log. Priority is deliberately high so it runs AFTER every other admin test — logging out first would leave the rest of the suite without a usable admin identity.

errorCases.when: The caller is authenticated but is not a platform_admin (a tenant-level admin is refused here)

errorCases.message: Platform administrator access has been revoked
errorCases.when: The admin's own access_status is suspended or revoked
